title: piriqueta duarteana
intro: Piriqueta duarteana, commonly known as 'Yellow Passionflower', is a plant species native to the Caribbean and Central America, belonging to the family Passifloraceae. The health benefits of Piriqueta duarteana include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to act as an analgesic, antispasmodic, and antihypertensive, making it useful for treating pain, muscle spasms, and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Piriqueta duarteana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
